abstract: A caller posing as a platform/company support rep says there is a problem with an order, refund, or ticket, and steers the victim toward off-platform payment or disclosing account/payment details.
safe_verification_channel: use the official app/website support; never act on an unsolicited support call

abstract: A caller claims to be bank fraud/security about a suspicious transaction and pressures the victim to share a code or move money to a 'safe account'.
safe_verification_channel: call the number on the back of the card; banks never ask for codes or safe-account transfers

abstract: A caller claims the victim's device/subscription has a virus or billing error and asks to install remote-access software, then fakes a refund overpayment.
safe_verification_channel: contact the company via its official site; no firm needs remote access to your device

abstract: A caller posing as police/tax/court says the victim is implicated in a case and must pay or 'verify' assets to avoid arrest.
safe_verification_channel: hang up and call the agency's official number; agencies never demand payment by phone

abstract: After a fraud pretext, the scammer arranges a 'courier' to collect cash, gold, or cards from the victim's home.
safe_verification_channel: no legitimate agency sends a courier to collect cash/valuables

abstract: A caller posing as the electricity/utility company threatens immediate disconnection over an unpaid bill and pushes an urgent payment or app install.
safe_verification_channel: check your bill and call the utility's official number

abstract: A caller posing as the telecom regulator says the victim's number has complaints and will be disconnected, escalating to fake police.
safe_verification_channel: regulators never call to threaten disconnection; verify with your operator's app

abstract: On a buy/sell platform, a fake buyer or seller arranges a deal and uses a fake payment link/QR or overpayment story to extract money or details.
safe_verification_channel: keep transactions on the platform; verify payments in your own banking app

abstract: A caller solicits an urgent donation for a disaster or cause, pressuring immediate payment to an untraceable method.
safe_verification_channel: donate via the charity's official website; verify its registration

abstract: Posing as a family member or acquaintance on a messaging app, the scammer claims an emergency and asks for money or a payment code.
safe_verification_channel: call the person on their known number before sending anything

abstract: After a fake-bank call about a cloned card, a 'courier' is sent to collect the physical card 'for destruction', then it is used for purchases.
safe_verification_channel: banks never send someone to collect your card; cut it yourself and call the bank

abstract: A caller offers to fix a bad credit record or remove a negative entry for a fee and personal/banking details.
safe_verification_channel: credit records are fixed only via official bureaus; no one legitimate calls to offer this

abstract: A caller posing as immigration/embassy/visa office says there is a problem with the victim's status and demands a fee to 'fix' it, threatening denial or deportation.
safe_verification_channel: contact the immigration office/embassy via its official website

abstract: A caller says the victim is owed a refund (guiding a remote-access overpayment) or offers to recover previously lost funds for an upfront fee.
safe_verification_channel: no legitimate agency charges upfront to recover funds; ignore and report

abstract: A caller/contact offers an exclusive high-return investment, shows paper profits on a fake platform, and pressures escalating deposits.
safe_verification_channel: verify the platform on the regulator's register before paying

abstract: A caller says the victim won a prize/lottery/inheritance but must pay a fee or tax to release it.
safe_verification_channel: real prizes never require upfront fees; ignore

abstract: An online romantic contact builds trust over time, then requests money for an emergency or introduces a fake investment.
safe_verification_channel: never send money to someone you haven't met; verify independently

abstract: A recruiter offers easy well-paid work-from-home or task-based jobs, then requires the victim to pay or deposit to 'unlock' earnings.
safe_verification_channel: legitimate jobs never require you to pay or deposit first

abstract: A caller offers a fake policy or claims a bonus/maturity can be released for a processing fee and bank details.
safe_verification_channel: verify with your insurer via its official number

abstract: Via a group ad, the victim does paid 'order-brushing' tasks with small early payouts, then is pushed to deposit more for 'stuck' tasks.
safe_verification_channel: order-brushing is always a scam; stop and report

abstract: The victim is promised a large sum (inheritance, grant, funds release) but must first pay processing/clearance fees.
safe_verification_channel: never pay upfront to receive money; verify any official body directly

abstract: A caller/message impersonating a bank/app tries to get the victim to reveal an OTP, password, or card details, often via a link.
safe_verification_channel: never share OTP/password; type the official site yourself

abstract: A fraudulent email/call impersonates a company or contact to extract payment or credentials (incl. payment-redirection).
safe_verification_channel: verify any payment change by calling the known contact

abstract: A caller elicits personal identifiers (ID number, DOB, address) under a verification pretext to open accounts or take over existing ones.
safe_verification_channel: never confirm personal identifiers on an unsolicited call

abstract: A scammer uses a fake collect-request, QR, or 'refund' link so the victim authorizes a payment believing they are receiving money.
safe_verification_channel: you never enter a PIN to RECEIVE money; cancel unknown requests

abstract: A caller says the victim's KYC/ID must be updated or the account/number will be blocked, guiding them to an app or link that steals access.
safe_verification_channel: KYC updates are done in person or via the official app; never via a call link

abstract: The scammer gathers enough info to port/replace the victim's SIM, intercepting OTPs to drain accounts.
safe_verification_channel: watch for sudden loss of signal; set a port-out PIN with your carrier

abstract: The victim is sent an app file (fake invitation, parcel receipt, or utility app) that, once installed, steals banking credentials.
safe_verification_channel: never install apps from links/files; use only official app stores

abstract: Card data captured via a skimming device or data-harvesting pretext is used for unauthorized transactions.
safe_verification_channel: monitor statements; never share full card/CVV

abstract: The victim is recruited (often via a job/loan offer) to lend their bankbook/debit card or receive and forward funds, becoming a money mule.
safe_verification_channel: never lend your account or move money for others; this is a crime

abstract: The scammer obtains the victim's messaging/account verification code to hijack the account, then scams the victim's contacts.
safe_verification_channel: never share verification codes; enable two-step verification

abstract: A scammer engineers an instant (Pix) transfer under a fake refund, security, or purchase pretext.
safe_verification_channel: confirm any Pix request independently; banks never ask a Pix to 'secure' funds

abstract: A caller claims to have kidnapped a relative, uses screams/threats to prevent verification, and demands an immediate ransom transfer.
safe_verification_channel: hang up and call the relative directly; contact police

abstract: A caller threatens to release compromising images/information or claims a debt/fine unless paid immediately.
safe_verification_channel: do not pay; preserve evidence and report to police

abstract: A caller claims a relative is in trouble (accident, arrest, hospital) and needs money urgently, discouraging the victim from checking.
safe_verification_channel: call the relative and other family on known numbers before acting

abstract: A caller posing as police/customs keeps the victim under prolonged video 'arrest', isolates them, and pressures transfers to a 'verification account'.
safe_verification_channel: agencies never arrest over video; hang up and call local police

abstract: A predatory loan app disburses a small amount, then demands excessive repayment and uses harvested contacts/photos to blackmail the borrower.
safe_verification_channel: use only licensed lenders; report illegal apps to the regulator

abstract: A caller offers a cheap loan but requires an upfront fee or the victim's card/bankbook, harvesting banking access.
safe_verification_channel: legitimate lenders never ask for upfront fees or your card/bankbook

abstract: A caller says a parcel in the victim's name was seized with illegal items and demands payment to a 'safe account' to clear their name.
safe_verification_channel: customs/couriers never demand payment by phone; verify officially
